title: Writers, John Marrero, and leaving the band in 1935
summary: Paul Barnes and Marrero wrote for the small band. She married in 1929, left in 1935 to raise her family and taught, then rejoined in 1953.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I think Paul Barnes wrote some things for the band, didn't he?
Oh, with that small band, yeah. And John Marrera. Of course, with the Lois Band, as I was saying, we had special writers. What kind of thing...
I mean, you played quite a long while with John Marrera, for instance. I mean...

Not too long. I imagine I played with John about two or three years, not longer than that. Because after that, Paul left town, I think, and John left town, and then there was a large... He created a large band. And then I stopped playing in 35 for 18 years. I didn't play with them anymore. I stopped in order to rear my family, because I married in 29. See, I joined in 26, I married in 29, and then I reared my family. After that, I stayed home to rear my family. I quit in 35. But during that time, I was still playing, but not regularly. Nor was I playing with them. I was playing... I was mostly teaching music then, in order to be home with my children, who were babies. And... I stayed out of the Celestine band for 18 years, and I rejoined in 53, and I've been there since. So there was an interim.
